camera.name: live-camera
camera.intrinsics_notes: PLACEHOLDER - NOT A CALIBRATION. fy was fitted on 10 desktop-camera images that were measured against ground truth, using the estimator's own pinhole equation d = obj_h * fy / bbox_height_px. The 10-sample images and the results that scored MAE 0.133 m / MRE 8.0% were removed from this tree during the Jetson deployment trim; both are recoverable at commit cd766f91. Those accuracy figures are CIRCULAR (fy tuned on the same data it was scored against) and must not be treated as expected field accuracy. REPLACE with a real chessboard calibration for the Orin Nano camera before trusting any distance reading.
